'''Annette Sawade''' (born 23 April 1953, [[Nordhausen, Thuringia|Nordhausen]]) is a German politician and a member of the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/webarchiv/abgeordnete/biografien18/S/sawade_annette-259054|title=Deutscher Bundestag - Sawade, Annette|website=Deutscher Bundestag}}</ref> She was a member of the German [[Bundestag]] from 2012 to 2017. She was a candidate in both the 2013 and 2017 German federal elections in the electoral district of Schwäbisch Hall – Hohenlohe.

From 1972 to 1976, she attended [[Humboldt University of Berlin]]. She is a member of the Evangelical Church.
